title: Senior Director of Analytics
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, Data Science, General Economics (JEL A)
text:
At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfillment, and personalization. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.
The Role
We're looking for a Senior Director of Analytics to lead our lean, multi-disciplined, best-in-class analytics team. As director, you will set the mission, technical direction, and culture of the analytics function. You will provide technical direction on product analytics, experimentation, attribution, forecasting, and manage analytical frameworks. You will promote a culture of discovering and communicating insights, as well as enabling self-service analysis capabilities for stakeholders. You will also evangelize and inspire best practices across the company.
You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with the Director of Data Platform and Directors in other functions such as Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Finance, and Marketing. Our stack includes AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Python, R and other best in class, modern tooling for business reporting, experimentation, and analysis. We are heavily invested in advanced AI-enhanced analytics tools across the company, and you will drive the evaluation, deployment and adoption of more powerful tools to scale self-serve analytics.
Responsibilities
Leadership and Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing, diverse analytics team
Foster a culture of deep analysis, commercial sense, innovation, best practices and evangelizing non-obvious insights (not simply reporting data)
Align team objectives with company goals and strategic initiatives
Apply strong commercial intuition, customer-focus and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making
Technical Direction and Innovation:
Provide expert guidance on horizontal technical analytical areas, including experimentation, attribution, forecasting, predictive analytics, and observability
Continuously identify opportunities for advanced analytics and data methodologies and enable implementation
Identify and track appropriate metrics to measure success across all areas of the business
Ensure trustworthiness and timeliness of data used by stakeholders from all departments of the company
Analytics and Strategy:
Collaborate with senior leadership to provide insights for decision-making around key initiatives and strategic objectives
Work with FP&A and product leads to align customer impact with commercial outcomes - working to a common growth model/metric tree
Stay abreast of industry trends, the competitive landscape, advances in technology, methodologies and tools, and market dynamics to inform commercial strategies
Data Strategy and Governance:
Partner with the Director of Data Platform to define and execute the vision for how data can be leveraged effectively across the business
Work alongside the Data Platform team to ensure high data quality and robust data governance
Develop and maintain analytics roadmaps to support the progress of the data strategy
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Empower the team to execute on reporting, analytics, and experimentation
Drive with product development to identify and apply new data opportunities
Drive understanding of key metrics and their importance across the business
Evangelize opportunities and trends discovered through insights across all stakeholders and ensure that insights and data lead to sound decision-making
Empower stakeholders through increased self-service usage of analytics tools, while freeing up analysts to contribute deeper insights requiring greater analytical skills
Requirements
Proven experience in a senior or head of analytics role, within e-commerce, marketplace or technology sectors
Strong leadership skills with a track record of managing large, multi-disciplinary teams
Expertise in doing analytical work, including data modeling, experimentation, attribution, forecasting, and observability
Experience leading product analytics and improving product experience based on analysis and insights
Experience introducing and driving adoption of agentic analytics to an organization
Excellent communication skills to articulate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders
Experience driving change through analytics and data initiatives
Strong in both high-level strategic thinking and detailed analysis
Benefits
Our Ways of Working: We all come into the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the option to work remotely or come into the office on the other days. We believe that in-person collaboration and community spirit is super important, which is why we spend some of our time in the office and some of our time at home.
Time Off: In addition to the 8 statutory bank holidays, you will receive 29 holidays per year. Lyst’s holiday year runs from 1 April to 31 March.
Competitive Family Leave Package: This includes Enhanced Family Leave for those eligible, paid Time off for Dependents and Support for Fertility Treatment & Loss.
Clothing Benefit: We want you to enjoy using the Lyst app and site as much as our customers, so we provide you with a clothing allowance to use on Lyst every year. This starts at £250 when you join and increases up to £1,000 with your length of service.
Private Healthcare: Our healthcare provider is Vitality. Your health is important to us which is why we offer all employees a comprehensive healthcare scheme from the day you start.
Training Allowance: We’re big on continuous learning and growth, so all employees are currently entitled to an annual training allowance of £1,000. This can be used to attend conferences, industry events, training courses and to purchase resources.
Pension Scheme: Our pension provider is The People’s Pension. We offer a minimum employee contribution of 5% and 3% employer contribution.
Eye Tests and Vouchers: Employees can make a saving on their eye test and glasses through our chosen provider. You’ll receive a free eye test every year and a discount towards glasses.
Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Lyst will purchase a bicycle from your chosen retailer, and you will then receive a voucher to pick up your bicycle from them.
Transport Season Ticket Loan: Employees can apply for an interest-free season ticket loan to support your travel to work.
Social Events: Frequent company-wide social events including Christmas & summer parties, sports days, themed drinks, quizzes, cook-alongs, as well as smaller team socials. We also have plenty of interest-based groups such as football, running club, book club, culinary and more.
We want to build a world where fashion works for everyone, and we want teams that are just as inclusive. Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture at Lyst. We recognise and celebrate the value and impact diversity brings to our company and are committed to ensuring this is a consistent focus, for which we are held to account. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply for this role. We are happy to talk about flexible working arrangements.
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Lyst we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
